question: What is the smallest source-complete deterministic observation that can distinguish same-turn simultaneous Ward/Warden's-Edge hand opportunity from the broader same-fight draw upper bound?

handMutationCensus: draw_cards appends one CardInst and immediately emits DRAW with uid and id
play_card removes one CardInst and immediately emits PLAY with uid and id
addCard can append directly to hand, but the exact current-main catalogue contains no base or upgraded addCard-to-hand effect
pyreTithe erases every held CardInst and emits one KINDLE with uid and id for each
end_turn discards the remaining hand and resets it to empty before the next TURN
kindle_from_hand removes one CardInst and immediately emits KINDLE with uid and id
sourceCompleteness.reconstruction: Start each fight with an empty hand. At TURN clear the reconstructed hand, at DRAW add uid and id, and at PLAY or KINDLE remove uid. A co-hand opportunity exists immediately after any event when at least one defend and one guardedStrike uid remain. End-turn discard does not require a new field because the following TURN clears state before new draws.
